function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

message.content: Shashi Tej Reddy is an Indian politician and former army officer who served as a Member of Parliament (MP) representing the Nandyal constituency in Andhra Pradesh. He entered politics with the Telugu Desam Party (TDP) and later joined the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). Reddy held the position of Minister of State for Defence (Independent Charge) in the Narendra Modi government from May 2019 until his resignation in March 2021 amid controversy over alleged misconduct. He has been involved in various public service initiatives, especially focusing on defense and veterans’ welfare.
